text: International affiliate study estimates junior share -1.9 percentage points, senior employment +6.7%, junior -2.5% (not statistically significant), relative to controls by March 2026.
limitations: Published empirical estimates, not directly observed causal changes. AI inferred from ads; foreign-headquarter peer-adoption exclusion assumption unverified; digitally attached multinationals not whole economies; no Malaysian forecast or structural-model interpretation.

text: Danish adoption-register study through December 2024 estimates near-zero average earnings/hours effects, rules out above 2%, and no differential early-career share decline at adopting workplaces.
locator: The other evidence belongs in the same picture
limitations: Observational comparison assumptions; 11 occupations, not later systems or every worker; publication March 2026 is not data date.

text: US CPS study through August 2026 finds no statistically significant recent-graduate unemployment increase in its comparisons; ages22-25 highest bachelor degree and not in school.
locator: The other evidence belongs in the same picture
limitations: Descriptive working paper; no identification of AI alone, no proof of no harms within occupations.
